mapper.sql: v.id, v.title, v.cover_url, v.duration_seconds, v.published_at, u.id AS owner_id, u.nickname AS owner_nickname, u.avatar_url AS owner_avatar, COALESCE(s.play_count, 0) AS play_count, COALESCE(s.danmaku_count, 0) AS danmaku_count, COALESCE(s.like_count, 0) AS like_count, COALESCE(s.favorite_count, 0) AS favorite_count, COALESCE(s.comment_count, 0) AS comment_count

EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM video_reaction r WHERE r.video_id = v.id AND r.user_id = #{viewerId} AND r.reaction_type = 1) AS liked, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM favorite_item f WHERE f.video_id = v.id AND f.user_id = #{viewerId}) AS collected, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM watch_later w WHERE w.video_id = v.id AND w.user_id = #{viewerId}) AS watch_later
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_id, name, description, cover_url, visibility, is_default, sort_order, item_count FROM favorite_folder WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY is_default DESC, sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT , FROM favorite_item fi JOIN WHERE fi.folder_id = #{folderId} AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.status = 1 ORDER BY fi.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite_item fi JOIN video v ON v.id = fi.video_id WHERE fi.folder_id = #{folderId} AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.status = 1

sql.if: AND (v.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN video v ON v.id = wl.video_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = v.owner_id LEFT JOIN video_stats s ON s.video_id = v.id
mapper.select:
SELECT wl.video_id AS id, CASE WHEN v.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.status = 1 AND u.deleted_at IS NULL THEN v.title ELSE '视频已失效' END AS title, CASE WHEN v.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.status = 1 AND u.deleted_at IS NULL THEN v.cover_url ELSE NULL END AS cover_url, v.duration_seconds, v.published_at, u.id AS owner_id, u.nickname AS owner_nickname, COALESCE(s.play_count, 0) AS play_count, COALESCE(s.danmaku_count, 0) AS danmaku_count, (v.id IS NOT NULL AND u.id IS NOT NULL AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.status = 1 AND u.deleted_at IS NULL) AS available, TRUE AS watch_later, wl.id AS list_entry_id, wl.created_at AS added_at, (SELECT h.progress_seconds FROM watch_history h WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND h.video_id = wl.video_id) AS progress_seconds FROM watch_later wl
WHERE
AND (wl.created_at, wl.id) ><
(#{query.cursorTime}, #{query.cursorId})
(SELECT anchor.created_at, anchor.id FROM watch_later anchor WHERE anchor.id = #{query.cursorId} AND anchor.user_id = #{userId})
ORDER BY wl.created_at ASC, wl.id ASC ORDER BY wl.created_at DESC, wl.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM watch_later wl
WHERE

SELECT , FROM video v JOIN `user` u ON u.id = v.owner_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN video_stats s ON s.video_id = v.id WHERE v.owner_id = #{userId} AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.status = 1 AND v.id < #{cursorId} ORDER BY v.published_at DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
